---
title: "Use profiles and internal gains"
lang: en
---
Use profiles affect energy demand, internal gains and hourly operation. The model allows scenario assumptions to be changed; the declaration uses its designated values.

**Excel location:** [👤 Nutzungsparameter]{.excel-menu .darkred} worksheet and the use-specific inputs in [District]{.excel-menu .darkred}.

::: {.excel-operation}
### In the Excel tool
Review the assigned use types and areas first. Then check plug-load demand, occupancy and schedules, lighting and internal heat gains. Keep energy use and the associated heat gains consistent with the project scope.
:::

Plug loads are electricity demand; the associated portion of the electricity becomes internal heat gains according to the model assumptions. Do not add the same heat contribution again as a separate gain. Internal gains affect heating and cooling demand and may be varied for scenario analysis.

::: {.declaration-note}
**For a declaration:** use the required declaration values and document project-specific evidence. Alternative schedules and gains remain useful for operational or sensitivity analysis.
:::

Source: [Training, slides 8 and 11](../downloads/schulung.pdf).
